title: The Politics of Indicators
passage: Institutions often govern through indicators because indicators make complex conditions easier to compare. Yet indicators can change behavior. This is not necessarily intentional gaming; people naturally respond to incentives. Consequently, a metric should be treated as a tool rather than a complete definition of success.
